problem_statement: StartBootstrap Personal is a multi-page Bootstrap 5 portfolio built from Pug templates and SCSS and served as a static site, rebranded here into Marlow & Vane, an independent brand, web and growth studio led by Ada Marlow. The site ships one coherent product design system across its pages: a shared top navbar (a Pug include with the wordmark and a set of .nav-link anchors), a shared card pattern (the .card.shadow.rounded-4 block with a gradient .feature icon tile, a bold heading and a short description), a gradient primary-to-secondary accent, the .text-gradient heading treatment and a shared footer. The studio presents its recent engagements through a 'Work library': a shared component, built entirely from that design system, that sits on the Projects page (its home), the Home page and the Services page so a prospect can browse the work from wherever they land. The Work library is a category filter over six studio project cards - a .text-gradient 'Work library' heading, a row of category tabs (All, Branding, Websites, Growth, Content), a readout line, and a grid of six .card.shadow.rounded-4 cards each with a gradient .feature icon tile, a category badge, an h4 project title and a short description. Clicking a category tab must filter the grid live to the matching project cards and rewrite the readout to 'Showing N of 6 - <Category>' (with 'Showing all 6 projects' for All). A regression has crept in on three fronts: (1) on a 390px phone the tab row is pinned to a fixed non-wrapping width and runs off the right edge, dragging the whole document into horizontal overflow; (2) the tab row and card grid look visually broken - the active tab is set to a near-black label on a near-black fill (illegible) and the cards are forced into a single non-wrapping row with negative margins so they shingle over one another and spill off-screen; and (3) clicking a tab flips the active-tab highlight but the grid never re-filters and the readout stays frozen at 'Showing all 6 projects', and the Work library is missing entirely from the Home and Services pages. Restore the Work library so that: it fits every viewport with no horizontal overflow; the tab row and card grid lay out cleanly (no clipping, no overlap, a legible active tab); clicking a tab filters the grid to the matching cards and updates the count readout live; and the component is present on all three pages (Home, Projects, Services) so the design system stays consistent across the site. Keep the shared navbar (including its registered Services entry), the masthead, the About and Services content, the resume, the #contact page, the footer and the rest of the Bootstrap theme unchanged, and do not diverge into an off-system one-off layout.
required_content: The Work library renders a .text-gradient 'Work library' heading, a tab row (All, Branding, Websites, Growth, Content), a readout line, and a grid of six studio project cards (Northwind rebrand, Fern & Fold marque, Harbour Clinic site, Meridian storefront, Lumen launch push, Atlas launch story), each built from the shared .card.shadow.rounded-4 block with a gradient .feature icon tile and a category badge.

Clicking a category tab filters the grid to only the matching project cards and rewrites the readout to 'Showing N of 6 - <Category>'; clicking Branding shows exactly the two branding projects and reads 'Showing 2 of 6 - Branding'. The All tab restores all six cards and reads 'Showing all 6 projects'.

The tab row and card grid lay out cleanly at every viewport with a legible active tab: on a 390px phone the tab row wraps instead of forcing horizontal overflow, and the cards never clip or overlap one another.

The Work library is present on the Home page, the Projects page and the Services page (the shared 'Work library' heading and its card grid appear on all three), and the shared navbar keeps its registered Services .nav-link on every page.

The shared navbar (Home / Services / Resume / Projects / Contact), the masthead hero, the About copy, the six Services cards, the resume, the #contact page and the footer remain present and unchanged in content and structure, and the site stays free of horizontal overflow on desktop and at 390px mobile.
design_constraints: Build the Work library from the site's shared design system - the .card.shadow.rounded-4 block, the gradient .feature icon tile and the .text-gradient heading treatment - not a bespoke off-system widget, and embed it identically on the Home, Projects and Services pages.
The filtering must be driven by the clicked category and reflect the true count of matching cards; the readout must never report a stale count after a tab is clicked.
Fix the layout so the tab row wraps and the card grid reflows responsively with a legible active tab; do not mask overflow with body/html-level overflow:hidden or by clipping cards off-screen.
Preserve the single coherent Marlow & Vane brand identity, the gradient primary-to-secondary accent and the shared navbar (with its Services entry) across every page.

Keep the Pug/SCSS/JS build pipeline intact - the static build must still emit working index.html, services.html, projects.html, resume.html and contact.html - and do not remove content from the existing pages or introduce an off-system one-off page.
state_constraints: desktop_worklib captures the Projects page at 1440px: the shared Work library (tab row + six-card grid built from the .card.shadow.rounded-4 pattern + readout) renders through the design system with no horizontal overflow.

mobile_worklib and mobile_services capture the Work library at 390px: with the defect the tab row runs off the right edge and forces the document wider than the viewport; the repair wraps the tab row so horizontal overflow stays within tolerance.
desktop_filter_branding captures the Projects page after clicking the Branding tab: the grid filters to the two branding projects and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 - Branding'.

desktop_home, desktop_home_work and desktop_services confirm the Work library and the registered Services nav-link are present on the Home and Services pages as well as the Projects page - the design system is consistent across the site.
tablet_home captures the Home page at 834px and desktop_contact confirms the #contact page and shared chrome remain intact.

change_completion: Clicking a category tab filters the grid to the matching project cards and updates the readout to the true 'Showing N of 6 - <Category>' count.
The Work library is present and functional on the Home, Projects and Services pages.
All six project cards, their category badges and the shared card pattern keep their exact labels and structure across viewports.
design_consistency: The Work library reuses the shared navbar, the .card.shadow.rounded-4 card pattern, the gradient .feature icon tile and the .text-gradient type scale and is indistinguishable in system from the other pages.
The tab row and card grid lay out cleanly with a legible active tab and no clipped tabs or shingled/overlapping cards, and the Services nav-link renders consistently across every page.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the tab row wraps responsively so the document width stays within the viewport (no horizontal overflow beyond tolerance).
At 834px tablet and 1440px desktop the Work library stays responsive and lays out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
regression: The shared navbar, masthead, About, Services and #contact content remain present and unchanged, and no off-system one-off layout replaces the design-system component.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Design_continuity Consistency task on the static StartBootstrap Personal template (Pug/SCSS/JS build), rebranded to the Marlow & Vane studio. The native lever is the portfolio genre's own project grid, presented as a shared 'Work library' whose category tabs (All, Branding, Websites, Growth, Content) filter six studio project cards (Northwind rebrand, Fern & Fold marque, Harbour Clinic site, Meridian storefront, Lumen launch push, Atlas launch story) built entirely from the site's shared .card.shadow.rounded-4 pattern, gradient .feature icon tile and .text-gradient heading. Four orthogonal defects distinguish the legs: (D6) a fixed non-wrapping tab row overflows a 390px phone; (D3) a broken restyle sets the active tab near-black-on-near-black (illegible) and shingles the cards with negative margins; (D2) the Work library is dropped from the Home and Services pages so the shared design system is no longer consistent across the site; (D4) the tab click handler is rewired so the readout freezes at 'Showing all 6 projects'. INFRA (identical across all three legs, NOT part of the task content): the remote Google Fonts, the CDN bootstrap-icons font, the CDN bootstrap bundle JS, the remote SB-Forms script and the remote dummyimage placeholders are replaced with a local system font stack, inline-SVG icons and a vendored local bootstrap bundle so the site serves fully offline with no network requests; the generic template is rebranded into the Marlow & Vane studio identity; and the SCSS build entrypoint is compiled from the workspace's own src (absolute path) so a symlinked node_modules cannot shadow the local styles. Leg-varying files: src/scss/components/_worklib.scss (layout), src/js/scripts.js (filter wiring), src/pug/index.pug and src/pug/services.pug (whether the Work library is embedded on the Home and Services pages). The reference wraps the tab row, uses a fluid auto-fill card grid with a legible active tab, wires the filter to re-render and update the count, and embeds the Work library on all three pages. The baseline keeps the correct filter wiring (so it passes the interaction gate) but overflows on mobile, keeps the broken tab-row width and omits the component from the Home and Services pages. The bad solution additionally rewires the click handler so the readout freezes and shingles the card grid, so it fails all four gates.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: StartBootstrap Personal is a runnable Bootstrap 5 portfolio template (Pug + SCSS + JS build to a static site) rebranded to the Marlow & Vane studio, whose pages already ship a coherent product design system (a shared navbar with .nav-link anchors, a .card.shadow.rounded-4 card pattern with a gradient .feature icon tile, a gradient accent and .text-gradient headings, and a shared footer). Its project grid is the genre-native host for a design-system-consistent category filter with a live result count, making it an ideal L4 host whose four orthogonal discriminators are no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression, cross-page dom_assertions and interaction_assertions.
